messages.content: "Could you first check the availability of a sculpture named 'The Thinker' made of bronze in the inventory using the 'sculpture_availability.check' function? Then, could you provide information about a sculptor named 'Auguste Rodin' using the 'sculptor_info.get' function? Lastly, could you calculate the estimated price to commission a sculpture made of marble, 10 feet in size, and with high complexity using the 'sculpture_price.calculate' function?"

function.name: sculpture_availability_check
function.description: Check the availability of a specific sculpture in the inventory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: sculptor_info_get
function.description: Get information about a specific sculptor. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: sculpture_price_calculate
function.description: Calculate the estimated price to commission a sculpture based on the material and size. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

material.description: The material used for the sculpture.

size.description: The size of the sculpture in feet.

complexity.description: The complexity level of the sculpture. Default is 'medium'.
